title: Tamsin and the Drop
author: Beatrix Dunmore
blurb: Paloma Thornbury, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
